# Leaders League names Burford as leading legal finance provider in UK and US


April 22, 2024


-
-
-
-


Leaders League has listed Burford Capital in the leading tier for legal finance for litigation and arbitration in both the US and UK. Burford's[Christopher Bogar](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/)t ,[Jonathan Molot](https://www.burfordcapital.com/team/people/jonathan-molot/) ,[Aviva Will](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/aviva-will/) ,[John Lazar](https://www.burfordcapital.com/team/people/john-lazar/) ,Mick Smith and[Jeffery Commission](https://www.burfordcapital.com/team/_people-container/jeffery-commission/)


are all recognized.


- View the US rankings


[here](https://www.leadersleague.com/en/firm/burford-capital/united-states/litigation-arbitration) .
- View the UK rankings[here](https://www.leadersleague.com/en/firm/burford-capital-1/united-kingdom/litigation-arbitration) .
